vectors.scenario: asset and cash receipts bind to identical economicTransactionId, legalBindingHash and expected obligation hashes
cash receipt carries a different economicTransactionId
rail receipt obligation hash differs from canonical obligation
rail receipt legal binding differs from transaction legal binding
asset and cash legs reuse the same source evidence hash
WORKS claims CORRELATED while independent verifier observes mismatch
receipt or correlation claims real-world FINAL

required_invariants: at least one asset obligation and one cash obligation
every required obligation has exactly one independently evidenced receipt
economicTransactionId matches across all required receipts
obligationHash matches canonical obligation per leg
legalBindingHash matches across transaction, obligation and receipt
sourceEvidenceHash cannot be reused to fake independent rail evidence
any disagreement forces UNCERTAIN or RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED
correlation itself never establishes legal or real-world finality
